title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. You may assume each input would have exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

examples.explanation: The answer is "abc", with the length of 3.

title: LRU Cache Implementation
description: Design a data structure that follows the constraints of a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache. Implement LRUCache class with get and put methods in O(1) time complexity.
constraints: capacity >= 1, get and put must operate in O(1) time complexity.

examples.explanation: Cache operations follow LRU eviction policy.

title: Merge k Sorted Lists
description: You are given an array of k linked-lists lists, each linked-list is sorted in ascending order. Merge all the linked-lists into one sorted linked-list and return it.

examples.explanation: The linked-lists are merged into one sorted list.

title: Reverse Words in a String
description: Given an input string s, reverse the order of the words. A word is defined as a sequence of non-space characters. The words in s will be separated by at least one space.

examples.explanation: Words reversed with single spaces separating them.

title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.

examples.explanation: The elevation map traps 6 units of rain water.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: You are given an array prices where prices[i] is the price of a given stock on the ith day. You want to maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy one stock and choosing a different day in the future to sell that stock.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 2 (price = 1) and sell on day 5 (price = 6), profit = 6-1 = 5.

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string s containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid.

examples.explanation: Brackets are closed in the correct order.
